findings.title: BOLA/NoSQL Injection — Admin flag extracted via cross-domain user enumeration
findings.description: The GraphQL endpoint /api/users accepts a raw MongoDB filter string in the 'search' parameter. The front-end JavaScript hardcodes a filter restricting results to is_admin=false and the @heytheregotrythis.com domain. By sending a modified filter {"is_admin": true} directly to the API (bypassing client-side restrictions), an attacker can enumerate all admin users across all domains. A second admin user (admin2@goodyoutriedsomethingelse.com) belonging to a different domain holds the CTF flag in a 'flag' field that is never exposed to the front-end.
